svg.text: verified = a real capability run on that part · supported = the toolchain can execute there, no run recorded · historical = a run on an earlier candidate
blocked = an upstream or physical limit · not routed = the launcher never sends work there · no GPU run = built, nothing measured. Hover a cell for the reason.
Rendering needs RT cores, which only L40S and RTX PRO 6000 have. Every image is linux/amd64, so aarch64 gpu-gb300 is uncovered.
